messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: Elevated 4xx rate on /v1/generate in us-west-2 — 429 spike starting ~10:38 UTC. Alert threshold breached (5m). Auto-page sent to oncall.

lia: I'm on it. Looking at the 5m dashboard now — 429s up ~6x baseline, 503s steady. Linking dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/abc123/response-codes?from=now-30m&to=now

sam: Oncall ack. Any tenant skew? If it's a single tenant we can surgical throttle. If broad, we'll need global shaping.

lia: Initial breakdown shows 78% of 429s attributable to tenant-472 (ingestion spikes). Host distribution concentrated on pool-gpu-08.

maria: Noted. tenant-472 had a deploy 09:50 UTC (canary). Kevin, any recent changes on ingestion for that tenant?

kevin: They pushed a change to batch-submission logic earlier this morning. I see increased concurrent streams from their client — looks like retry storm.

lia: Running quick prometheus query to confirm per-tenant QPS and 4xx ratio.

lia: ```
# PromQL
sum by (tenant) (rate(http_requests_total{path="/v1/generate",status=~"4.."}[1m]))
/ sum by (tenant) (rate(http_requests_total{path="/v1/generate"}[1m]))
```

lia: tenant-472 4xx% = 42% last 3m, baseline 3%. Others are flat ~2-4%.

sam: Ok. Plan: 1) apply per-tenant hard QPS cap to tenant-472 2) enable temporary stricter global token-bucket for pool-gpu-08 3) open a temporary fallback routing to model-compact variant for that pool if latency spikes.

maria: Agree. I'll coordinate routing change if needed.

lia: Executing per-tenant QPS cap now.

lia: ```
# throttlectl command
throttlectl set-tenant-quota --tenant tenant-472 --qps 12 --reason "auto-mitigation 429 spike" --expiry 60m
```

deploy-bot: throttlectl: applied quota for tenant-472 -> 12 qps (expires in 60m). :white_check_mark:

kevin: I can follow up with the tenant to ask them to roll back the batching change. I'll open a support ticket.

sam: Applying pool-level shaping now to reduce burst concurrency on pool-gpu-08.

sam: ```
# routectl
routectl set-pool-shape --pool pool-gpu-08 --max-concurrent 120 --burst 30 --reason "429 mitigation" --expires 45m
```

deploy-bot: routectl: applied shaping to pool-gpu-08. Current concurrent now ~95 -> target 120.

lia: Watching 429s: dashboard shows initial drop from 6x -> ~2.5x over the next 4 minutes. 503s unchanged which implies backend capacity OK.

sam: Good. Can you check KV cache hit rates? If caching is bypassed by tenant patterns it could amplify load.

lia: Cache hit for model-default unchanged (~86%). tenant-472 is showing low prefix cache hits (21%). They're sending lots of unique prompts.

maria: If cache hit is low and their traffic is the bulk, QPS cap will help. I'll prepare a fallback rule to route tenant-472 to model-compact if their latency or error rate goes above threshold.

kevin: I pushed a quick support DM to their engineering lead, flagged for rollback and add jitter to retries.

lia: 429s continuing to trend down. Current 4xx rate at 1.8x baseline, tenant-472 contribution down to 28%.

sam: Let's keep the tenant cap for at least 45m and schedule gradual relaxation after we confirm steady state. Also file an incident ticket for postmortem and runbook updates.

lia: Creating incident tracker now.

lia: ```
# incident create
incident-cli create --sev 2 --title "429 spike — tenant-472 retry storm" --assignees lia,sam --components inference-routing
```

incident-bot: Incident INC-2026-847 created. SEV2. Link: https://incidents.redwood.com/INC-2026-847

maria: Quick ask — can we add a grafana panel that shows per-tenant 429% trend and a heatmap by pool? This would make future triage faster.

sam: Agreed. Change request filed to observability backlog.

lia: Note for handoff: I'll be wrapping up in ~25m. If 429s stay >1.5x baseline or tenant-472 remains >20% contribution, please keep caps in place and start deeper analysis of their client patterns and request shapes.

kevin: Support ticket created with tenant-472 (SUP-9981). They acknowledged and will pause their new rollout.

lia: 12:03 UTC update: 429 rate back to near-baseline, tenant-472 now 9% of errors. I'll leave the 12 qps cap with 60m expiry and reduce pool shaping expiry to 30m.

lia: ```
throttlectl extend --tenant tenant-472 --expiry 60m
routectl update-pool-shape --pool pool-gpu-08 --expires 30m
```

deploy-bot: throttlectl: expiry extended. routectl: pool expiry updated.

sam: I'll follow-up with a deeper root-cause tomorrow; likely client-side retry/backoff bug. Also we should consider adding an automated per-tenant adaptive throttle that triggers on 4xx ratio spike.

maria: Noted — add to Optimize backlog and design doc. For now, good mitigation and clear progress. :thumbsup:

lia: Handing off to sam for overnight watch — summary: applied tenant-472 qps=12, pool-gpu-08 shaping applied, tenant contacted and paused roll, 429s returned to baseline. Incident link: https://incidents.redwood.com/INC-2026-847

sam: Taking over. I'll monitor dashboards and escalate if error rates climb. Lia — thanks for the quick mitigation. I'll draft postmortem outline tomorrow.

kevin: Thanks everyone. I'll coordinate the tenant follow-up and share logs in the incident.

incident-bot: Reminder scheduled: postmortem due in 72h for INC-2026-847.

lia: :white_check_mark: closing thread from my side; open for any follow-ups here."
